summary: Adds the storefront building blocks relative to the delivery baseline and documents homepage composition and viewport acceptance in the versioned Skill and MCP knowledge.
migration: Install the 0.2.0-candidate.2 / 0.1.0-candidate.6 pair and restart the project MCP. Follow the storefront composition section in DISTRIBUTION for homepage work. Opt into the sticky storefront header via @yami/design-system/components/Header.
rollback: Restore the previously verified paired tarballs and consumer lockfile, revert imports added for that upgrade, then restart the project MCP.
visualAndBehavior: Compared with 0.2.0-candidate.1, the update is design guidance for desktop offer visibility, mobile shortcuts and product visibility, and page heading semantics. Verify assembled pages using the stated desktop and mobile browser viewports.
